# DotnLott

> Enterprise-grade business workflow automation, custom integrations, AI-powered solutions, and premium website development.

DotnLott (A2Z Version Private Limited) is a registered Private Limited company based in Cuttack, Odisha, India, serving clients globally. We specialize in transforming manual operations into blazing fast automated workflows.

## Key Services

- **Workflow Automation & Integrations**: CRM synchronization, lead outreach autopilots, and API integrations.
- **AI Automation**: Custom AI agents, chatbot development, and email/sales pipeline automation.
- **Custom Website Development**: Next-generation web applications, headless commerce, and high-performance landing pages.
